notes.title: 08.04.2019 Update
notes.content:
Hi, everyone!

Added controller support! However, it is not in a perfect state, and since Love, Sam is designed to be played with keyboard and mouse, it is still recommended to use a game pad only when you have no other choice. Below is a quick button guide.

-'Bottom Face Button' or 'Right Trigger' = 'Mouse Left Click' (Interact, Pick Up, etc)
-'Right Face Button' or 'Left Trigger' =Mouse Right Click' (Get Up From Chair, Put Down Item, etc)

Also, I am currently working on several issues regarding puzzle difficulty, and need your help. Love, Sam is a story driven game, so it is important to maintain a certain flow during gameplay. If you've experienced anything during the puzzle sections that hinders this experience, please describe them freely by commenting on this announcement or using the Steam Community Hub.

Thank you.
